notes.title: 25.11.2024 1.0.5b2 Update Log + Developer Note
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed formatting and staying focused in text chat.
[*] Fixed some control assignments not being valid.
[*] Fixed an issue with being able to start the game alone.
[*] Characters now take damage from hitboxes on their bodies, removed the old capsule collider.

notes.title: 19.11.2024 1.0.5 Update Log + Developer Note
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now view and edit button assignments in-game by clicking the “Button Configuration” button from the “Settings” menu.
[*] You can now view the people you have blocked from your lobbies, view their profiles or unblock them from the “Server Variables” menu.
[*] Profile photos can now appear in the player list in the pause menu, and you can view players' Steam Profiles by clicking on their names.
[*] Added text chat. When your player is alive, you can text chat with players within 20 meters of you, and if you are dead, you can text chat with other dead players.
[*] Fixed some parts of the player not showing up in the killer view.
[*] Fixed player's speech icons not showing up in some situations.
[/list]
[h3]Developer Note[/h3]
In the survey we conducted with valuable players on our Discord server, the concept of “Abandoned hospital map” as a new map idea resulted in a majority of votes. I will be coming soon with a new map and improved gameplay, so stay tuned and join us!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/5GDJ53ZKyq

notes.title: 14.11.2024 1.0.3 Update Log + Developer Note
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed fonts in Japanese and other languages.
[*]HOST players can now update certain lobby variables while in the waiting area.
[*]In the player list in the pause menu, you can see which players are talking, dead/alive.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could climb on trees.

[*]Fixed a bug where players who were jumping high when the game ended would suddenly die when the game restarted.
[*]Turned off keyboard control of some interface elements.

I was unable to push updates due to the Steam Guard restriction, with this update you can now experience version 1.0.3. Feel free to let me know any bugs you encounter. I'll be slowly moving on to more fun features, you're invited to our Discord server for polls and to join us.

I also decided to keep the game free for a while longer, thanks to everyone who played and enjoyed <3

notes.title: Version 1.0.0 Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello,

I've decided to release the game out of early access with version 1.0. This doesn't mean I'm going to stop updating the game, I'll still keep it up to date and will continue to innovate according to your requests.

Thank you to the 190,000+ players who have experienced the game so far.

With the full release, the game will remain free for the first week, after which it will be made paid again at a cheap and ethical price. Don't forget to add the game to your library while it's free!

Your opinions are important to me and you can reach me on Discord, Steam Discussions and YouTube.

(We may even be lurking among you).[/b]

[i]SEE YOU ON THE NEXT UPDATE![/i]

notes.title: 30.10.2024 Update Log 3 + IMPORTANT DEVELOPER NOTE
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello![/h3]
Sorry for flooding you guys with updates, but I have good news, I REALLY fixed the spawning of weapons. Yes, my friends and I tested it many times and everything was great. Please forgive me, I'm trying to keep up with everything all day long on my own. I also want to thank everyone in the community for their moral support, you guys are like family to me.

The version has changed, so some of the servers may remain on the old version, they will be migrated to the new version.

Love you all <3

notes.title: 30.10.2024 Update Log 2 + Developer Note
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed fade effects from player names.
[/list]
[h3]Developer Note[/h3]
It's hard to believe, but the names on the characters were the main cause of the game's lag, especially in alphabets like Chinese, it was reloading the TMP Text component every frame, so we were experiencing a huge framerate drop. To solve this, we removed the fade effect of the names, and in technical terms, we made sure that if the variables are the same, they will not reload. So you will no longer experience lag. I've tried it and I approve it.
